entities.name: Nikolaus Hagenauer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikolaus Hagenauer was a German late gothic sculptor from Hagenau. He was most likely born as Niklas Zimmerlin, but was also documented and signed works as Niclas Hagenauer, Niklaus Hagenauer, Niclas Hagnower, Niklaus Hagnower, Niclas von Hagenau and other variants.
